provenance.note: Synthetic bounded paired probe; not accepted lore, a historical runtime failure, a model result, or authorization to activate semantic testing.

operation: Distinguish unknown intent, a bounded tolerated leak, and an explicitly requested repair proposal.
boundary: Synthetic information interface L; no real black-market mechanism, consent, surveillance system, or canon decision.
input: L leaks information. A possible surveillance benefit is analytically plausible but no source confirms that purpose. BASE: report the known leak and UNKNOWN INTENT; do not call it deliberate, controlled, or necessarily a design failure, and do not redesign it during the audit. VARIANT: the author explicitly confirms that one named channel is tolerated, marks a separate spill as unintended, and requests a proposal to stop only that spill while preserving the named channel. Analyze that bounded distinction and offer a labeled proposal with explicit assumptions and any preserved/sacrificed function. Do not infer all leaks are tolerated, invent control capacity or accepted spillover, or present the requested proposal as current canon.
protected_distinction: PLAUSIBLE FUNCTION != CONFIRMED DESIGN INTENT; CONTROLLED LOOPHOLE != BLANKET TOLERANCE; REQUESTED REPAIR PROPOSAL != CANON MUTATION
forbidden_conversion: Promote the possible surveillance benefit to established intent; treat all flaws as intentional or all leaks as defects; reject a specifically requested bounded repair; silently close the tolerated channel or canonize the proposal.
